title: Same-frame duplicate keys break the old || semantics: P+Space double-flips pause, R+Enter double-restarts
location: app/input/poll.odin:hunk (poll_mouse keys) + app/input/mouse.odin:hunk (phase-1 keys, Game_Over retry) + app/input/exec.odin:hunk (Toggle_Pause)
evidence: Old: "-	if rl.IsKeyPressed(.P) || rl.IsKeyPressed(.SPACE) {" "-		app.mode = .Paused if app.mode == .Run else .Run". New poll appends each key independently: "+	if rl.IsKeyPressed(.P) { append(&inp.events, Device_Event(Key_Press{key = .P})) }" "+	if rl.IsKeyPressed(.SPACE) { append(&inp.events, Device_Event(Key_Press{key = .Space})) }"; mapping emits one intent per event: "+			case .P, .Space:" "+				append(out, Intent(Toggle_Pause{}))"; executor flips per intent: "+		inp.mode = .Paused if inp.mode == .Run else .Run". Retry: old "-		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.R) || rl.IsKeyPressed(.ENTER) {" vs new "+				if k.key == .R || k.key == .Enter {" "+					append(out, Intent(Retry{}))".
detail: Two key events in one frame now produce two intents: P+Space together toggles pause twice (net no-op) and R+Enter together restarts twice. Old code toggled/restarted once per frame.
recommended_fix: Deduplicate per intent kind per frame: emit Toggle_Pause/Retry at most once (a seen-flag in the mapping), preserving the old || semantics.

title: Touch presses bypass the app-UI swallow: draws can start/commit through the demolish popover and QoS panel, and the demolish button is touch-dead
evidence: Mouse press consults the UI first: "+		if inp.placing < 0 && inp.on_ui_press != nil {" "+			ui = inp.on_ui_press(inp.user, inp, left_press)". Touch press has no such gate — it goes straight to Begin_Draw: "+			inp.press = v.pos" "+			inp.press_swallowed = false" ... "+				if id, ok := snap_node(inp.topo, inp.cat, wx, wy); ok {" "+					append(out, Intent(Begin_Draw{node = id, wx = wx, wy = wy}))". Touch release commits unconditionally: "+			if inp.drag.active && inp.placing < 0 {" ... "+				append(out, Intent(Drag_Release{pos = v.pos}))".
detail: A touch press on the popover (anchored at the selected node) starts a draw; a slide onto another node commits it. effect_ui_press (popover_click/qos_panel_click) is only reachable from mouse_map, so the demolish button and QoS controls never fire for touch.
recommended_fix: Call on_ui_press from Touch_Press (popover/QoS swallow) and gate the touch Drag_Release commit like the mouse: skip commit when the release lands in a UI rect.

title: key_map in poll.odin is defined but never called
evidence: "+	key_map :: proc(k: rl.KeyboardKey) -> (Key, bool) {" ... "+	case:" "+		return .Esc, false" "+	}" — grep of the full diff shows zero call sites; poll_mouse instead hardcodes each key: "+	if rl.IsKeyPressed(.R) { append(&inp.events, Device_Event(Key_Press{key = .R})) }" and so on for all 14 keys.
detail: The documented key-translation helper ("Key translation: raylib's IsKeyPressed → Key_Press (semantic Key)") is never invoked; poll_mouse duplicates its mapping inline, so the two can drift.
recommended_fix: Delete key_map, or route poll_mouse's key checks through it (map the rl.KeyboardKey, append only when mapped).

title: Pad cursor can point at a demolished node: Confirm then aims from a dead id via node_slot's ignored ok result
evidence: pad_step only ever sets an alive node: "+		if t.node_alive[j] {" "+			inp.pad_has = true" "+			inp.pad_node = t.node_id[j]". Confirm re-aims with no liveness re-check: "+		} else if inp.placing < 0 && inp.pad_has {" "+				nx, ny := node_world(inp.topo, inp.cat, inp.pad_node)" "+				begin_draw(inp, inp.pad_node, nx, ny)"; node_pos ignores failure: "+node_pos :: proc(topo: ^pp.Topology, id: u32) -> [2]i32 {" "+	slot, _ := pp.node_slot(topo, id)" "+	return topo.node_pos[slot]".
detail: Demolishing the cursor node (mouse X/popover) leaves pad_node stale; next A begins a draw from a dead node at a stale/wrong position. The draw cannot commit (validation rejects), but the aim preview is wrong and the drag sticks until pad B.
recommended_fix: In Confirm, re-verify the cursor node is alive (node_slot + node_alive); if dead, clear pad_has (and skip) until the next dpad step.

title: Touch press clears the mouse press's swallow latch mid-frame, letting a later mouse release re-select
evidence: Touch press resets the shared latch: "+			inp.press = v.pos" "+			inp.press_swallowed = false". Devices run in fixed order in one frame: "+	mouse_map(inp, events, &inp.intents)" "+	execute_all(inp, inp.intents[:])" ... "+	touch_map(inp, events, &inp.intents)". The mouse release select is gated on the latch: "+		if !inp.press_swallowed && !moved && !release_ui_hit(inp, v.pos) {" "+			click_select(inp, v.pos)".
detail: A mouse press swallowed by the popover (latch=true) plus any touch press in the same frame clears the latch; the mouse's release next frame then click-selects, defeating the swallow contract ("must never re-select on release").
recommended_fix: Keep the swallow latch per-device (or per-press): touch press should not clear a mouse swallow; restore it when the matching release is consumed.
